meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 aeon 这个 Python 时间序列库写代码:完成分类、回归、预测等任务,产出可运行的 scikit-learn 风格脚本。
howto.when: 当你处理时间序列数据或序列模式,需要分类、异常检测等专门算法时触发;支持单变量与多变量序列,要求 Python 3.10 以上并安装 aeon。

say.text: 用 aeon 对这个时间序列数据集做分类,告诉我准确率
say.note: 它会加载数据并训练分类器

say.text: 用 aeon 检测这段序列里的异常点
用 aeon 的 ROCKET 提取特征,再喂给 sklearn 分类器
say.note: 输出特征提取加分类的代码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes aeon-based Python code for time series tasks such as classification, regression, and forecasting, producing runnable scikit-learn style scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work with temporal data or sequential patterns needing specialized algorithms like classification or anomaly detection. Supports univariate and multivariate series.

say_en.text: Use aeon to classify this time series dataset and tell me the accuracy
say_en.note: It loads the data and trains a classifier

say_en.text: Use aeon to detect anomalies in this series
say_en.note: Returns anomaly scores and a threshold

say_en.text: Extract features with aeon ROCKET, then feed them to sklearn
say_en.note: Outputs feature extraction plus classification code
